sentences.text: Tricleidus is a member of the family Cryptoclididae, a group of marine reptiles.
Andrews first named Tricleidus in 1909, designating Tricleidus seeleyi as the type species.
There are three recorded fossil occurrences of Tricleidus in the Paleobiology Database.
The species T. svalbardensis was transferred to the genus Colymbosaurus in 2012.
This animal lived during the Toarcian to Oxfordian stages, between 184.2 and 154.8 million years ago.
Its fossils have been found in the Agardhfjellet Formation in Norway.
